title: Mother dies, father and sons injured as birthday party becomes bloodbath
article: It was supposed to be a celebration - a birthday party with video games and a sleepover visit from a cousin in a house in Oshawa, east of Toronto. It ended in a stabbing that left a mother dead, her two young sons and their father in hospital, and another man fatally shot by police.

The rampage began at dusk on Saturday, when a man police identified as Gino Petralia, 47, became involved in an altercation at a townhouse complex in south Oshawa, blocks from the sprawling General Motors plant. Police responded to an emergency call from a woman who said she had been stabbed. They arrived to find Mr. Petralia in a nearby unit. He is believed to have pulled a knife on Richard Kelly during a dispute and his wife stepped in to protect her family.

Several shots were fired by officers, the Special Investigations Unit confirmed yesterday, including one that ripped through the drywall into an adjacent home. As luck would have it, the couple who lived there were not in the room when the bullet pierced their wall.
The Kelly family was not so lucky.

Leslie Kelly, 26, was stabbed to death. Her three-year-old son, Nathan, is fighting for his life in Toronto's Hospital for Sick Children. Five-year-old son Riley is in stable condition in the same hospital. Richard Kelly, Ms. Kelly's 29-year-old husband, is recovering from serious injuries after surgery at Sunnybrook Health Sciences Centre in Toronto. The Kelly's other child, Brandon, the 11-year-old birthday boy, was unharmed, as was a 12-year-old cousin and a 13-year-old boy whom neighbours identified as Mr. Kelly's half-brother and Mr. Petralia's son.

Yesterday, as white-suited forensic investigators combed the tidy brown-brick and white-aluminum-sided home for clues, friends and neighbours stood behind police tape watching or trying to go about their business without the cars that were trapped behind police lines.
"You know how people say something was a bloodbath? This was a bloodbath," said a shaken friend who asked that her name not be used. "It was just a nightmare. There was so much blood it was insane."

The woman, who described herself as a friend of the family, said the Kellys had taken in Richard's teenaged half-brother after his mother died earlier this year. She described Ms. Kelly as a "fantastic mother and wife."

In a Facebook group created to remember the mother, friends and family posted more than 100 pictures of Ms. Kelly, many of them smiling with her small sons. The photos include shots from the couple's wedding and Christmas portraits of the couple with their new extended family of four boys.
"It's just sad that you had to go so soon," one posting reads. "You were so kindhearted and so beautiful."

Neighbours said this is not the first time the two-storey townhouse complex has been the scene of a crime, although several said they believed things had improved from years ago. Last year, police were called when a fight between two men resulted in murder.
The complex, which was converted to condos from rental units years ago, has more than 160 units. Property records show that Ms. Kelly bought the home in June.

The Special Investigations Unit has been called in because of the shooting of Mr. Petralia by a police officer. Spokesman John Yoannou said one officer is being questioned as a subject and six others are being questioned as witnesses.
